faq.a: Zulekha is associated with the Arabic form زُلَيْخَا, whose core sense is zulekha; potiphar's wife (traditional name).

faq.q: What is the origin of Zulekha?
faq.a: Zulekha is associated with Arabic. Zulekha is Arabic زُلَيْخَا (Zulaykhā), the name traditionally given to the wife of Potiphar in the Joseph story.
Yes — the underlying form زُلَيْخَا is Arabic.
Zulekha can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Zulekha should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Zulaykhā is not a Quranic personal name, though the story is alluded to in the Quran.

faq.q: What does Zulekha mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Zulekha is rendered زلیخا and carries the sense زلیخا، عزیز مصر کی بیوی.

faq.q: What does Zulekha mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Zulekha is rendered زلیخا and carries the sense زلیخا، زن عزیز مصر.
